request.subject: PORTRAIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Change three things only. The helmet: a closed great helm covering the face, with a narrow dark eye slit and a gold cross on its front under the crimson crest; no face shows. The shield: removed completely; in its place a big round steel pauldron rimmed in gold and steel plate. The sword: a broader, longer greatsword blade with a gold crossguard. Do not redraw anything else: keep the crimson tabard with the gold cross, proportions, outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
